document: FV Library Research Sources — canonical read-only source inventory
source_method: Authenticated edit-context WordPress raw Gutenberg content; extracted fv-rs-card anchors from two HTML blocks.
caveats: Inventory is the immutable source-card snapshot of WordPress #1338 as of 2026-11-16, with per-URL verification annotations added afterward; no titles, categories, source URLs or item-level reuse cues were changed.
Landing-page access is not a guarantee of individual image/document access, complete downloading, or public-domain status. Rights require a record-level determination.
403, 406 and automated restrictions are NOT broken-link determinations; browser/permission follow-up is required.
USAspending and NARA Catalog return JavaScript shells here; search interactions were NOT tested.
Published WordPress static labels still say 60 though there are 90 cards; the existing PR is release-held.
No live WordPress changes are authorized under the unresolved production-theme accessibility and subscriber/social suppression gate.
All 90 original destination URLs have now been attempted in a public textual reader; no assertion that 90 interactive experiences or underlying documents work.
Observed institutional content is 64/90; other outcomes are explicitly classified, not called dead links.
Site-specific research and media use require an item-level license and ethical/privacy review; CC0 is limited to specifically marked Smithsonian assets.
Public WordPress labels and stale NARA card still await actual production-theme QA, suppression evidence and a guarded WordPress update.
